paper.title_en: Circulation and operational sparsity of analogue Hawking radiation in rotating acoustic horizons
paper.abstract_en: Temporal sparsity compares the mean interval between emitted quanta with a characteristic single-quantum timescale. We study this operational quantity for the rotating draining-bathtub acoustic horizon in two spatial dimensions. The Hawking temperature is fixed by the radial drain and does not depend on circulation, while the geometric capture width and the transmission spectrum do. A geometric black-body benchmark therefore predicts reduced temporal separation as circulation increases. We then solve the radial scattering problem and compute converged greybody-corrected number and energy fluxes, including the superradiant sector. At a circulation-to-drain ratio of unity, the thermal-clock sparsity is 0.44 whereas the spectrum-based sparsity is 1.82. The former crosses the temporal-overlap benchmark near a ratio of 0.40, while the latter remains above unity at all sampled circulation ratios. We also show that the binned sparsity definition is logarithmically infrared sensitive in two spatial dimensions. Rotation therefore enhances the number flux while hardening the spectrum, making temporal overlap intrinsically dependent on the operational clock used to resolve the emitted quanta.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究了旋转声学视界中的模拟霍金辐射的操作稀疏性，提供了灰体修正的通量计算和超辐射分析，属于黑洞热力学在模拟系统中的应用，理论深度和严谨性良好。
decision.title_zh: 旋转声学视界中模拟霍金辐射的循环与操作稀疏性
decision.abstract_zh: 时间稀疏性将发射量子之间的平均间隔与特征单量子时间尺度进行比较。我们研究了二维空间中旋转排水浴缸声学视界的这一操作量。霍金温度由径向排水决定，不依赖于循环，而几何捕获宽度和透射谱则依赖于循环。因此，几何黑体基准预测随着循环增加时间间隔减少。然后我们求解了径向散射问题，并计算了收敛的灰体修正粒子和能量通量，包括超辐射扇区。在循环与排水比率为1时，热钟稀疏度为0.44，而基于谱的稀疏度为1.82。前者在大约0.40的比率附近穿过时间重叠基准，而后者在所有采样的循环比率下都保持在1以上。我们还证明了在二维空间中，分箱稀疏度定义在红外上是对数敏感的。因此，旋转增强了粒子通量，同时使谱变硬，使得时间重叠本质上依赖于用于分辨发射量子的操作钟。
